The dates marked tbd follow.

```{=html}
<style>
/* The next lecture: KU red on the left, a light surface behind */
tr.next-lecture td { background: var(--surface) !important; font-weight: 400; }
tr.next-lecture td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent2); }
/* Dates and slide links on one line */
main table td:nth-child(2), main table td:nth-child(4) { white-space: nowrap; }
/* Phones: the table scrolls sideways in its own box, not the whole page */
@media (max-width: 767.98px) { main table { display: block; overflow-x: auto; } }
/* Assignment dates and the break: date and text in grey, behind the lectures */
main table tr:has(.plan-minor) td:nth-child(2),
main table tr:has(.plan-minor) td:nth-child(3) { color: var(--accent); font-size: 0.875em; }
</style>
<script>
// Highlights the next lecture: the first lecture row (not an assignment date
// or the break) whose date is today or later. Dates are in 2027; rows without
// a date are skipped.
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const months = {Jan: 0, Feb: 1, Mar: 2, Apr: 3, May: 4, Jun: 5};
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  for (const row of document.querySelectorAll('main table tbody tr')) {
    const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td');
    if (cells.length < 3 || cells[2].querySelector('.plan-minor')) continue;
    const m = cells[1].textContent.match(/(\d{1,2})\s+(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun)/);
    if (!m) continue;
    if (new Date(2027, months[m[2]], parseInt(m[1], 10)) >= today) {
      row.classList.add('next-lecture');
      break;
    }
  }
});
</script>
```
